svg.aria-label: wp-alchemist: WordPress plugin framework. A scaffolder and runtime for modern WordPress plugins: lifecycle, feature modules, permissioned REST routes, schema-driven settings, migrations and Vite assets. Built with PHP 8.1, Composer, Vite, MIT.
